item.title: Trump on Venezuela: "We will run the country until we can do a safe, proper and judicious transition"
item.description: In the aftermath of one of the most direct intervention in Latin America since the 1989 invasion of Panama, President Donald Trump has said that the United States will temporarily take control of Venezuela following the capture of its longtime leader, Nicolás Maduro. item.description: Real Madrid has started 2026 in a promising way, with a 5-1 thrashing to Real Betis in LaLiga, and a very rare circumstance: all five goals were scored by Spanish homegrown players, from La Fábrica, the club's academy.
